newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Huan Hsin offers 50 mln shares in Singapore IPO.
newsitem.headline: Huan Hsin offers 50 mln shares in Singapore IPO.

text.p: Huan Hsin Holdings Ltd, a manufacturer and supplier of wires and cables for the telecommunications industry, said on Thursday it was offering 50 million new shares at US$0.42 each in its Singappore initial public offer (IPO).
Huan Hsin said in a statement the share offer, for listing on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore, was made up of 37 million placement shares and 13 million public shares.
The offer represented 25 percent of its enlarged share capital of 200 million shares.
The company said up to five million shares would be reserved for staff.
The offer price of US$0.42 each represents a historic price earnings ratio of 8.82 times.
It said it would raise proceeds of about US$19.7 million to be used to set up new plants, to purchase machinery, to repay a loan from Huan Hsin Taiwan, and for working capital.
For the financial year ended December 31, 1996, Huan Hsin recorded a net profit of Singapore $9.98 million on a turnover of S$47.32 million.
The share offer will close on June 9. Trading on a when issued basis will start on June 11.
The offer is lead managed by OCBC Bank.
